+"""Unexecuted MonetDB authorization behavior scenario runner."""
+
+from pathlib import Path as _AC_Path
+_AC_CHECKS_DIR = _AC_Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+
+def run_query(scenario, query):
+    role = query.get("role", "root")
+    user = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER", "monetdb") if role == "root" else role
+    password = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_" + role.upper())
+    if password is None:
+        password = scenario.get("credentials", {}).get(role)
+    argv = [os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_MONETDB_CLIENT", "mclient")]
+    for env_name, option in (("ACREPAIR_HOST", "--host"), ("ACREPAIR_PORT", "--port"),
+                             ("ACREPAIR_DATABASE", "--database")):
+        value = os.environ.get(env_name)
+        if value:
+            argv += [option, value]
+    argv += ["--user", user]
+    if password is not None:
+        argv += ["--password", password]
+    argv += ["--statement", query["sql"]]
+    try:
+        p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True,
+                           timeout=int(scenario.get("query_timeout_seconds", 60)))
+        return {"role": role, "sql": query["sql"], "returncode": p.returncode,
+                "stdout": p.stdout, "stderr": p.stderr}
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        return {"role": role, "sql": query["sql"], "returncode": 124,
+                "stdout": exc.stdout or "", "stderr": "SQL_TIMEOUT"}
+
+
+def output_text(result):
+    return (result["stdout"] + "\n" + result["stderr"]).lower()
+
+
+def is_success(result):
+    text = output_text(result)
+    return result["returncode"] == 0 and "!sqlexception" not in text and "!" not in text
+
+
+def matches(result, expected):
+    if "success" in expected and is_success(result) != expected["success"]:
+        return False
+    if "stdout_contains" in expected and expected["stdout_contains"].lower() not in result["stdout"].lower():
+        return False
+    if "error_contains" in expected and expected["error_contains"].lower() not in output_text(result):
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main():
+    scenario = json.loads(Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR / 'scenario.json')).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    checks, transcript = [], []
+    target_bug_signature = False
+    for step in scenario["steps"]:
+        for query in step["queries"]:
+            result = run_query(scenario, query)
+            transcript.append(result)
+            if step["kind"] == "setup":
+                if not is_success(result):
+                    raise RuntimeError("MONETDB_SETUP_FAILED: " + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+                continue
+            passed = matches(result, query["expect"])
+            checks.append({"name": step["name"], "kind": step["kind"], "passed": passed,
+                           "actual": result, "expected": query["expect"]})
+            if step["kind"] == "target":
+                target_bug_signature = matches(result, query.get("bug", {}))
+    controls_ok = all(c["passed"] for c in checks if c["kind"] == "control")
+    fixed_behavior_passed = bool(checks) and all(c["passed"] for c in checks)
+    print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps({
+        "checks": checks, "reproduced": target_bug_signature,
+        "fixed_behavior_passed": fixed_behavior_passed and controls_ok,
+        "origin": scenario["origin"], "transcript": transcript,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
